title: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER - FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255
snippet: Disclosures must be prominent, unambiguous, and placed above the fold or in the primary caption/visual overlay so an ordinary consumer cannot miss them before engaging with content.

title: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER - EU Digital Services Act Article 26
snippet: Influencer commercial communications must clearly state the commercial nature of the communication and identify on whose behalf the promotional material is presented.

title: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER - Statutory Withholding on Independent Contractor Remuneration
snippet: Payer entities are required to deduct statutory withholding at the applicable prescribed rate from each gross milestone disbursement unless a valid tax exemption certificate is lodged.
